prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, choose_path layout, finish copy, home layout, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout).
Redesigning adoption screens (adoption, redesign) and adding hints to sign-in (sign_in, hint) were helpful and produced multiple winning tests.
Copy revisions on path selection (choose_path, copy) and adding new screens at the finish step (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance.
No clear effect was seen for waiting screen tweaks (home hint, notification, redesign) or finish screen hints and redesigns (finish hint, redesign).
Adding waiting info (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect in early rounds but eventually produced a winning test.
Predictions were generally higher than noise-corrected measured outcomes, though some late-stage layout changes significantly outperformed predictions.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Two-column layout redesign for photo upload screen: Reorganizes the custom pet photo upload step into a two-column view separating upload guidelines from the visual image selector. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption median time is 89s.)
1: [adoption, redesign] List layout redesign for photo upload screen: Redesigns the custom photo upload screen into a list layout with explicit photo quality criteria and visual guidelines. (why: Multiple support emails reported custom pet generation failures and improper pet visuals.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder sign-in screen after pick friend screen: Moves the sign-in step to occur immediately after choosing a pet companion, securing authentication before photo upload. (why: 8 support emails mentioned reset pets after signing in later, so authenticating right after choosing a friend reduces loss.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Stall prevention load hint on sign-in screen: Adds an inline status hint reassuring users while sign-in credentials and network connection are verified. (why: 2 support emails reported sign-in screen stalling or failing to load.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop pet spawn alert notification on waiting screen: Adds a sound and visual completion alert toggle on the waiting screen when desktop pet rendering finishes. (why: Home drop-off is 14.4% with a 201s median wait time, leading to user drop-offs before desktop placement.)
5: [choose_path, new_screen] Path preview showcase screen before selection: Inserts a path showcase screen presenting visual comparisons between preset adoption and custom pet creation. (why: Path selection has a 16.9% drop-off rate and a high mean completion duration of 514s.)
6: [finish, hint] Desktop pet control keymap hint on home intro screen: Displays a control quick-reference hint box explaining key bindings and tray menu controls on the final intro screen. (why: 3 support tickets noted confusion regarding how to control, hide, or interact with the pet post-onboarding.)
7: [finish, redesign] Card layout redesign for home intro screen: Converts the final home intro screen into structured cards outlining controls, interactions, and settings. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 69.9% with a long median time of 395s.)
8: [choose_path, hint] Mascot guidance hint on story screen: Adds a friendly mascot tip box on the story screen highlighting desktop companion benefits before path selection. (why: 16.9% of users drop off before completing choose_path, indicating early engagement drop.)
